description: The constant functions f_i(n)=i have no common pointwise bound. The function g(n)=n+1 strictly exceeds f_i at all n at least i, but no single threshold makes it exceed every constant simultaneously.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.FiniteErrorsAndCountableDiagonalization.constant_bound_example :
  (¬∃ g, ∀ (i n : ℕ), i ≤ g n) ∧ (∀ (i n : ℕ), i ≤ n → i < n + 1) ∧ ¬∃ N, ∀ (i n : ℕ), N ≤ n → i < n + 1
